record.title: FDIC insured-depository resolution route
record.sub: Recover or resolve a failed institution
kv: Federal Deposit Insurance Act and the applicable FDIC receivership authority.
A failed insured depository institution enters the statutory FDIC resolution/receivership framework.
Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation acting as statutory receiver; FDIC-appointed receivers; Assuming depository institutions under the approved resolution transaction

Confirm the failed entity is the relevant insured depository institution. Identify the receiver, deposits/accounts, assuming institution or payout path, and claim class. Separate the bank from its parent, nonbank affiliates, custodial arrangements, and token issuer obligations.
FDIC insurance/resolution is not SIPC protection, does not insure investment losses or token value, and does not automatically cover a bank affiliate or a customer claim against a nonbank issuer.
Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation: FDIC publishes deposit-insurance and failed-bank resolution materials.
